sources.title: Toward Better Depth Lower Bounds: A KRW-like theorem for Strong Composition
sources.author: Or Meir
sources.role: Primary strong-composition/direct-sum context; explicitly identifies the missing theorem that composition behaves like direct sum and that direct-sum costs add.

sources.title: Simple general magnification of circuit lower bounds
sources.role: Primary general hardness-magnification candidate; supplies nonlinear amplification targets below known lower-bound thresholds, but constructive error extraction and SAT certificate transfer remain to be proved for C031.

sources.title: The Direct Sum of Universal Relations
sources.author: Or Meir
sources.role: Positive direct-sum theorem in a communication model; useful as a model for explicit sharing control, but it does not change the input-length exponent of parallel repetition.

sources.title: Hardness Amplification Beyond Boolean Functions
sources.role: Recent quantitative hardness amplification with explicit circuit blow-up accounting; average-case/non-Boolean setting, not yet a constructive SAT refuter bridge.

admission_note: Source map only; no external theorem is promoted beyond its stated model or assumptions.
